features.title: Capture it without switching apps.
features.description: Numbers, addresses, shopping lists, ideas, measurements, call notes and things you need to remember — capture them immediately while keeping the current screen visible.

cards.title: Slide-out panel, always at hand
cards.description: Drag or tap the handle at the edge of the screen and jot down what you need right away.

cards.title: Pen, highlighter and eraser
cards.description: Write, draw and highlight. Made a mistake? It is easy to fix.

cards.title: Adjustable transparency
cards.description: See the app under the panel while you write. Set the transparency the way you like.

cards.title: Text, drawing and photos
cards.description: Add text, drawings and photos to one note. Move, resize, rotate or crop a photo.

cards.title: Paper your way
cards.description: Choose clean, lined, grid or dotted paper. Longer text continues on the next page.

cards.title: Saves itself
cards.description: Your unfinished note is saved automatically. You can carry on with it even after a restart.

cards.title: Keep notes organized
cards.description: Sort notes into folders and mark favorites. To find something, just type a word from your typed text.

cards.title: Lock your notes
cards.description: Keep personal notes locked. You unlock them the same way you unlock your phone.

cards.title: Easy sharing
cards.description: Send a whole note as a PDF or a single page as an image.

cards.title: Back up notes and reminders
cards.description: Back up your notes and reminders to your phone or Google Drive. By hand or automatically every day.

cards.title: Reminders with SlideInk PRO
cards.description: Type a note and set a time. SlideInk will remind you.

cards.title: A handle that suits you
cards.description: Choose its color, size and side of the screen. And whether the panel opens with a tap or a drag.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Create reminders from typed notes or from a home screen widget, where you can also dictate them. Repeat them every day, week, month or year, and Meeting mode keeps them quiet for 1 to 4 hours. Creating reminders is free for 14 days from your first saved reminder; after that, a one-time SlideInk PRO purchase unlocks it. It is not a subscription.

cards.title: Straight from your note
cards.description: Type what you must not forget and tap the bell. Pick Evening, Tomorrow, 15 minutes or your own date and time.
cards.alt: The typed note “Buy tomatoes on the way home” over a recipe page with quick reminder times and a custom date and time

cards.title: A card over the app you are using
cards.description: At the right time, the reminder pops up over whatever you are doing. Swipe left to snooze it, right to hide it in the bell, or down to hide all reminders at once.
cards.alt: The reminder card “Buy tomatoes on the way home” over the recipe page with Snooze and Done

widgets.title: Notes and reminders from your home screen.
widgets.description: Add a SlideInk widget and start a note or a reminder with one tap. Widgets work even when SlideInk is turned off. Note widgets are free. Creating new reminders is free for 14 days from the day you save your first reminder; after that, it requires SlideInk PRO. Existing reminders keep working.
widgets.how_text: Touch and hold an empty spot on your home screen, tap Widgets and find SlideInk.

support.title: Need help with SlideInk?
support.intro: Have a question, found a bug, or need help with SlideInk? Email us — answers to common questions are below.

faq.a: SlideInk needs permission to display over other apps. Open SlideInk and allow it when asked, or turn it on in your phone's Settings under Apps › SlideInk.

faq.q: The handle disappears after a while or after a restart.
faq.a: Some phones, for example Xiaomi, OPPO or Huawei, stop apps in the background. In your phone's settings, allow SlideInk to autostart or run in the background and turn off battery optimization for it.

faq.q: How do I turn the handle off for a while?
faq.a: Open the SlideInk app and tap Stop SlideInk. The handle disappears from the edge of the screen until you tap Start SlideInk. Your notes stay saved, and widgets work even when SlideInk is turned off.

faq.q: My reminders don't arrive on time.
faq.a: Allow notifications for SlideInk and, when asked, enable precise reminders (Alarms & reminders). Battery saver settings can also delay reminders.
Voice input uses your phone's speech recognition service, for example from Google. Make sure it is installed and enabled.

No. You buy SlideInk PRO once and nothing is charged again. Notes are free. You need PRO only to create reminders, and you can try that for free for 14 days from your first saved reminder. Existing reminders keep working.

faq.q: How do I get SlideInk PRO on a new phone?
faq.a: Sign in with the same Google account you used to buy SlideInk PRO. The purchase is restored automatically — you don't pay again.

faq.q: Are my notes transferred to a new phone?
faq.a: Yes, with a backup. In SlideInk, open Backup and save your notes and reminders to a file or to Google Drive. On the new phone, install SlideInk and restore the backup before adding anything new, because restore works only in an empty SlideInk.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: SlideInk is designed to keep your notes, drawings and reminders on your device. The app does not require an account and does not use analytics, advertising, or tracking services.

sections.title: Who operates SlideInk
paragraphs: SlideInk is developed under the Majo Studio developer account and published by M-S-K Slovakia s.r.o. This Privacy Policy applies to the SlideInk Android app. It also applies to the slideink.app website.

sections.title: Notes, drawings and reminders
paragraphs: Handwritten notes, drawings, typed text and reminders — including their text, time and repeat settings — are stored locally on your device. SlideInk does not upload them to a developer-operated server. They are copied outside SlideInk only when you back them up or share them.
SlideInk does not require user registration or a SlideInk account.

sections.title: Voice input
paragraphs: When you create a reminder by voice, SlideInk opens the speech recognition service installed on your device (for example, from Google). The audio is processed by that service under its own privacy terms.
SlideInk does not record or store audio and does not request microphone permission. It receives only the recognized text, which becomes the text of your reminder.

sections.title: Notifications and widgets
paragraphs: SlideInk uses notifications to alert you to reminders at the selected time and to keep the floating handle available. Reminder notifications are marked as private, so a locked screen shows only “Reminder” unless your device settings allow full notification content.
Home-screen widgets are shortcuts for creating a note or a reminder, or opening the Library. They do not display the content of your notes or reminders.

sections.title: Sharing notes
paragraphs: Sharing is initiated only by you. When you choose to share a note, SlideInk may create a temporary PNG or PDF copy in the application cache and pass it to Android's standard sharing interface. The destination is selected by you.
SlideInk does not automatically send shared content to the developer.

sections.title: Google Play Billing
paragraphs: SlideInk uses the Google Play Billing service for purchases such as SlideInk PRO. Purchase processing is handled by Google Play. SlideInk receives the purchase status needed to determine whether PRO access is available.

SlideInk PRO is a one-time purchase with no automatic renewal — it is not a subscription. SlideInk checks your purchases with Google Play to restore PRO, for example after reinstalling the app or on a new device.
SlideInk does not receive or store your full payment-card details. Information handled by Google Play is subject to Google's own privacy terms and policies.

sections.title: Analytics, advertising and tracking
paragraphs: SlideInk does not use analytics services, does not display advertising, and does not include advertising or third-party tracking SDKs.

sections.title: Backup and restore
sections.note: SlideInk does not participate in Android cloud backup or Android device-to-device data transfer. You can back up your notes and reminders yourself to one file, manually or automatically once a day, in a place you choose, such as a folder on your phone or Google Drive. The file is never sent to the developer. It is not encrypted and also contains locked notes, so keep it only in a place you trust. You can restore it into an empty SlideInk, for example on a new phone.

sections.title: Data retention and deletion
paragraphs: Notes and reminders, including completed reminders, remain on the device until you delete them or uninstall the app. Temporary files created for sharing may remain in the application's cache until they are removed by the app, Android, or by clearing the app cache. Backup files stay where you saved them until you delete them.
Purchase records processed by Google Play are retained according to Google's policies and your Google account settings.

sections.title: App permissions
sections.intro: SlideInk may use Android permissions and system capabilities needed for its features, including:
items: displaying the floating handle and drawing panel over other apps;
running the overlay service in the foreground while it is enabled;
scheduling precise alarms so reminders arrive on time;
vibration when a reminder alerts you;
restoring the handle and rescheduling reminders after the device restarts;
hiding other apps' overlays over SlideInk's own permission and setup screens, for your security;
using Android’s fingerprint or screen-lock verification to open locked notes; SlideInk does not receive or store your fingerprint or other biometric data;
using Google Play Billing for purchases.
sections.outro: SlideInk does not request access to your microphone, contacts, location or photos. These capabilities are used only to provide SlideInk features and are not used for advertising or analytics.

sections.title: Third-party services
paragraphs: Google Play may process information required for app distribution and purchases, and your device's speech recognition service processes voice input when you use it. These services are governed by their own privacy policies and terms. If you save a backup with a storage service such as Google Drive, that service handles the file under its own terms.

sections.title: Email support
paragraphs: If you contact us by email, we use your email address and message only to answer you. We do not share them with third parties and will delete them on request.

sections.title: This website
paragraphs: The slideink.app website is hosted on GitHub Pages. When you visit it, GitHub may process technical data such as your IP address to deliver and protect the site, under GitHub's privacy statement. The website does not use cookies, analytics or trackers; it only remembers the language you choose, in your browser's local storage.

sections.title: Changes to this Privacy Policy
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy may be updated when SlideInk features, data practices, or legal requirements change. The current version will be published on this page with its updated date.
